research:
I found 8 items from the last 14 days (21 Oct to 4 Nov) that a beginner could use or would ask about. These come from search summaries, not from reading each page, so check the date and plan details on the official link before a reel says them out loud. A few official pages were thin or didn't turn up, and those are marked.

**New free tools and features**

1. **Gemini can now create and edit files inside the chat (30 Oct).** You can ask it to make or edit a PDF, document or spreadsheet without leaving the chat. It's free for all Gemini users in every supported language. PDFs work on phone and web; the other file types are web-only for now. *Why a beginner cares:* "make my resume a PDF" or "turn this list into a sheet" now happens in one app, for free. Kind: tutorial. [Gemini release notes (India)](https://gemini.google/in/release-notes/?hl=en-IN) · [Beebom](https://gadgets.beebom.com/news/gemini-can-now-create-and-edit-pdfs-docs)

2. **Free textbooks inside Gemini Notebook, including S Chand, in Hindi (around 30 Oct).** Gemini Notebook is the new name for NotebookLM since July. Its built-in library now has books from OpenStax, Open Textbook Library and S Chand Publishing, covering subjects in India and the US. It works on web and phone, in English and Hindi among other languages. *Why a beginner cares:* students can study from a real textbook with AI that answers only from that book, which means it makes things up less. Kind: tool. [ETV Bharat](https://www.etvbharat.com/en/technology/gemini-new-features-gemini-notebook-free-textbooks-gemini-edit-pdf-docs-sheet-gemini-immersive-education-enn26103004754). I didn't find Google's own post.

3. **Gemini Notebook now opens from inside the Gemini app (23 Oct, rolling out slowly).** It's a "Connected App" now. Google's help centre says Gemini *can't* add your chats to a notebook through it, even though some launch articles claim it can. *Why a beginner cares:* one less app to learn. The catch is that it may not be on your account yet. Kind: tool. [Gemini release notes](https://gemini.google/in/release-notes/?hl=en-IN)

4. **Canva Craft, Canva's own image generator (22 Oct).** It's open to all users from the Dream Lab tab. Faster versions are "coming soon." *Why a beginner cares:* shop owners and freelancers already make posters in Canva, and now the AI image is in the same place. Check whether free accounts have a daily limit before saying "free." Kind: compare (Canva Craft vs Gemini or ChatGPT images). [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/22/canva-releases-its-first-image-generation-model/) · [Canva newsroom](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-create-2026-ai/). The newsroom link is the wider Canva AI 2.0 post, not a Craft-only post.

**How AI works / things people get wrong**

5. **ChatGPT now flatters you less (29 Oct).** OpenAI changed GPT-6 in ChatGPT to give "more concise, less flattering responses" for Free, Go and signed-out users. *Why a beginner cares:* it's an admission that AI tends to agree with you and praise your idea. That's a strong explainer on why "great idea!" from AI is not proof. Kind: explain, and it fits the backfire theme. [OpenAI model release notes](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9624314-model-release-notes)

6. **Privacy: "Does AI train on my chats?" Nothing changed in the window, but people keep asking.** I found no new policy change in the last 14 days. The settings as they stand:
   - **ChatGPT:** trains on personal chats unless you turn off "Improve the model for everyone" in Data controls.
   - **Claude:** trains only if you allow it.
   - **Gemini:** tied to the Keep Activity setting.
   - Turning it off usually doesn't remove chats that were already used.

   *Why a beginner cares:* people paste Aadhaar numbers, salary slips and client files into chats. Kind: tutorial ("turn this off in 20 seconds"). [OpenAI release notes](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes) · [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news/announcements). Check each company's current privacy page before showing a screen. The guides I found were third-party.

**Scams using AI**

7. **PNB warns about AI voice-clone and deepfake fraud (advisory dated 20 to 26 Oct).** Scammers copy a family member's voice to fake an emergency and rush a UPI transfer. Some use deepfake videos of "police" for "digital arrest" threats. PIB's advice is to call the person back on a number you already have before you pay. If money is lost, call the helpline 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in. *Why a beginner cares:* every family WhatsApp group needs this, so it's very sendable. One survey figure (McAfee, 47% of Indian adults have met a voice scam) is a survey, not an official count, so label it that way. Kind: explain. [NewsMobile on PNB advisory](https://www.newsmobile.in/fraud-and-scam/pnb-alerts-customers-to-ai-voice-cloning-deepfake-and-phishing-frauds/). I didn't find PNB's own page.

**Coming soon (test only)**

8. **WhatsApp is testing separate Meta AI chats (4 Nov, Android beta only).** You'd be able to start several separate Meta AI chats from your chat list. *Why a beginner cares:* Meta AI is the AI most Indians already have. Don't present it as live; it's beta 2.26.44.6 for some testers. [PhoneWorld, citing WABetaInfo](https://www.phoneworld.com.pk/whatsapp-introduces-separate-meta-ai-chats-on-android/)

**Just outside the window, still useful**
- **ChatGPT Hindi voices (from 15 Oct):** two Hindi voices in ChatGPT Voice. It's 20 days old, but a good fit for this audience. [CareerIndia](https://www.careerindia.com/news/openai-india-strategy-2026-hindi-voices-hinglish-android-features-011-67243.html)
- **PIB Fact Check "Quantum AI" scam (May 2026):** fake deepfake videos of the Finance Minister promising ₹3,00,000 a month on a ₹22,000 investment. It's old, but it's real proof for a "spot the fake AI scheme" reel. [PIB Fact Check on X](https://x.com/PIBFactCheck/status/2058478208106815507)

**What I left out:** Claude's late-October launches (Duet research preview, Financial Advisors, Nonprofits plugin, Google Cloud access) are for businesses or developers, not phone beginners. Gemini Chrome auto browse in India (7 Oct) is too old and needs AI Pro. I found nothing new for CapCut, Galaxy AI in Hindi, Apple Intelligence in India or Pixel in this window.
